title: 毎日王冠の後に・その名は

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a fierce and heated race, Grass Wonder comes out on top!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Victory is hers, but she can't find the words to describe the feeling. All she can do is bask in the afterglow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now she looks ahead to her second, more focused shot at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week, who was spectating today's race, is left speechless by her friends' ever-growing abilities. As she stares on in shock, Maruzensky approaches her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Prompted by Maruzensky's words, Special Week breaks through her complex feelings and runs off, inspiration rekindled.
